title: Bioinformatics Lead
description:
**Job description**

We are seeking an experienced Bioinformatics Technical Lead to drive our computational biology initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 68 years of industry or academic experience (PhD or Masters in a relevant field) with a proven track record in developing and refining high-throughput pipelines for omics data, including RNA-seq, methylation, and new NGS modalities. This highly technical position requires creativity and an aptitude for developing novel computational algorithms. You will work directly with distinguished professors from leading institutions such as MIT, Caltech, Harvard, and others. This role is primarily an individual contributor position with limited leadership responsibilities, guiding a small team (24 highly qualified bioinformaticians) in a technical capacity rather than acting as a full-time manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pipeline Development & Optimization

* Design, implement, and optimize scalable, production-grade pipelines for NGS data analysis (RNA-seq, whole-genome, whole-exome, methalomics, NIPT development, novel PCR analysis etc.).
* Ensure reproducibility, efficiency, and accuracy of computational workflows.

* Algorithm & Data Analysis

* Develop and apply novel computational algorithms for gene expression profiling, variant calling, haplotype calls and other genomic analyses.
* Perform rigorous data mining and statistical analyses to extract actionable insights from large datasets.

* Technical Leadership

* Guide and mentor junior bioinformaticians and computational scientists.
* Conduct code reviews, provide technical feedback, and champion best practices across the team.

* Collaboration & Cross-Functional Engagement

* Work closely with molecular biologists, data scientists, and software engineers to translate project goals into robust computational strategies.
* Communicate results, provide data-driven recommendations, and contribute to scientific publications and intellectual property (as appropriate).

* Quality & Compliance

* Maintain high standards of data integrity, documentation, and version control.
* Implement quality control checks and validation strategies for all workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education:
* + PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or related field; or
  + Masters degree with significant, demonstrable experience.
* Experience:
* + 6-8 years of hands-on experience analyzing high-throughput NGS data, with an emphasis on RNA-seq.
  + Proven track record of developing and deploying production-level bioinformatics pipelines.
* Technical Skills:
* + Strong programming background in at least one major language.
  + Familiarity with HPC clusters or cloud computing environments.
  + Expertise in data mining, machine learning, or statistical modeling techniques relevant to genomics.
* Leadership & Communication:
* + Prior experience in a lead role, supervising or mentoring junior team members.
  + Excellent written and oral communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g., CLIA, CAP, or similar).
* Familiarity with workflow management systems (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake, Cromwell).
* Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Singularity) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Publications or patents in computational genomics or related areas.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
* Adaptability and willingness to embrace new technologies and methodologies.

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer will define and execute automation test strategies, build robust frameworks using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java, integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and QA partners to ensure requirement clarity, end-to-end test coverage, and defect prevention.

Key Skills

UI automation: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright as the preferred tool, with Selenium as a plus.

API testing and automation: Strong experience with REST API testing using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, and Java or JavaScript/TypeScript based API automation.

Framework design: Ability to design and enhance scalable automation frameworks using hybrid, keyword-driven, data-driven, BDD, and Page Object Model approaches.

Programming: Strong coding proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Java with an automation-first engineering mindset.

End-to-end testing: Ability to connect UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and functional test coverage across application flows.

CI/CD and DevOps: Experience with Jenkins, Git, pipelines, test reporting, debugging tools, and continuous testing practices.

Quality engineering fundamentals: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, quality gates, defect prevention, and test coverage strategy.

Cloud and infrastructure: Working knowledge of AWS or cloud-based device/browser farms such as BrowserStack.

AI-assisted testing: Ability to use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate script creation, refactoring, and documentation.

Additional exposure: Performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling, accessibility testing, security testing, and regulated domain experience are preferred.

Required Qualifications

6–8 years of experience in QA, software testing, or quality engineering.

At least 4 years of hands-on automation testing experience across UI and API automation.

Strong experience building automation frameworks and reusable test components.

Hands-on experience with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript; Java experience is strongly preferred for API automation.

Experience with REST API testing and automation using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams with distributed stakeholders.

Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to mentor junior QA engineers, conduct automation code reviews, and influence quality practices across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other regulated domains.

Exposure to performance, security, and accessibility testing for web applications.

Working knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms.

Experience improving automation maturity, test stability, release confidence, and sprint quality metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Requirement clarification: Partner with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and technical teams to ensure test scenarios align with business intent and acceptance criteria.

Backlog and test planning: Participate in grooming and sprint planning, refine acceptance criteria, define test coverage, and ensure automation opportunities are embedded into sprint scope.

Automation framework ownership: Design, develop, maintain, and enhance scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, RestAssured, Postman, and Newman.

UI and API test development: Build reusable test components, utilities, test data strategies, service validations, API contracts, and end-to-end automated test flows.

Execution and reporting: Execute automated regression, smoke, functional, integration, and API test suites; analyze results, identify failure trends, and communicate actionable insights.

CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into Jenkins/Git-based pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates, and faster release feedback.

Defect identification and RCA: Identify defects early, perform root cause analysis, collaborate with developers on permanent fixes, and improve defect prevention practices.

Testability and engineering partnership: Collaborate with UI and backend engineers to improve testability through stable selectors, test IDs, API readiness, mocks, data setup, and service-level validation.

UAT and business support: Support business users during UAT cycles with test clarification, quick triage, and validation support.

Documentation and best practices: Maintain test documentation, automation guidelines, reusable templates, framework standards, and coding best practices.

AI-assisted quality engineering: Use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate automation creation, refactoring, documentation, and productivity.

Continuous improvement: Drive improvements in automation coverage, test reliability, execution efficiency, sprint quality metrics, and release confidence.

Team leadership: Mentor junior QA engineers, support automation code reviews, promote knowledge sharing, and influence quality-first engineering behaviors.

Work shift: Work in overlapping time zones with US teams as required to support collaboration and delivery continuity.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Java,Postman

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Infrastructure Team Leader
description:
**Infrastructure Lead | DIAN Technology Solutions**

**Role: Infrastructure Lead**

**Location: Saudi Arabia**

**Work mode: Full time Onsite**

**Domain: Banking**

**Visa: Company sponsors**

**Technology Stack:** WSO2 API Gateway, IAM, Strapi, Apache Camel, Redis and ELK

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a seasoned Infrastructure Lead with a heavy focus on Linux Automation and enterprise stability. You will be the backbone of our application stack, responsible for ensuring 99.9% uptime through robust configuration management and proactive system engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Automated Deployment Pipelines:** Standardize and manage end-to-end deployment processes across all environments (SIT, UAT, Regression, Production, and DR), ensuring seamless integration and consistent application stack management through automated CI/CD workflows.

**Advanced Linux Automation:** Design and implement automation scripts and workflows to streamline regular deployments, patching, and system configurations.

**Infrastructure Management:** Take full ownership of RHEL and other Linux-based enterprise activities. Manage scaling and integration for the application stack across all controlled environments.

**Operational Resilience:** Lead 24/7 support for critical issues. Conduct quarterly Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises and backup testing to guarantee RTO/RPO targets are met.

**Security & Compliance:** Enforce RBAC, data encryption, and privacy standards. Ensure the platform remains compliant with PCI-DSS and GDPR through rapid patching (within 30 days) and vulnerability remediation.

**Performance & Monitoring:** Utilize performance fine-tuning to meet strict application SLAs. Maintain detailed audit logs, health checks, and proactive monitoring to identify issues before they impact users.

**Collaborative Leadership:** Coordinate with internal IT, InfoSec, and third-party vendors. Manage the escalation matrix, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and maintain high-quality documentation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

**Experience:** 8–12 years in Linux Systems Engineering and Enterprise Operations.

Automation Mastery (Must-Have): Expert proficiency in Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Chef for configuration management and infrastructure-as-code, Strong Shell, Python, or Perl scripting skills.

**OS Expertise:** Deep knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, kernel tuning, and security hardening.

**Orchestration:** Hands-on experience with Kubernetes clusters and containerization.

**Middleware & Data:** Knowledge of WSO2 APIM/IS, Redis in-memory data stores, and the ELK Stack for centralized logging.

**Network Security:** Familiarity with load balancers, firewalls, and secure integration patterns.

**Certifications:** RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer) is a must. CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) is highly preferred.

Application Question(s):

* Are you open to relocate to Saudi Arabia?

Work Location: In person

title: Professional, Network Engineering
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
--------------------------

As a **Network Operations Center (NOC) Engineer at Danfoss,** you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the stability, security, and performance of our global IT infrastructure. Your expertise will directly impact seamless connectivity for thousands of employees worldwide, enabling them to innovate and deliver exceptional results. By proactively monitoring and optimizing our network, you will help safeguard business continuity and contribute to building a resilient, future-ready digital ecosystem.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Monitor and Optimize: **Perform 24/7 shift-based monitoring of global network performance** , identifying and resolving issues before they affect operations.
* Respond and Resolve: Act as a key responder for network incidents, conducting diagnostics and troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
* Maintain and Improve: Execute routine maintenance tasks such as firmware updates, configuration changes, and hardware replacements to keep our network robust.
* Secure and Comply: Implement Zero Trust security principles using tools like ClearPass to ensure secure network access.
* Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with cross-functional IT teams to integrate network solutions seamlessly with other systems.
* Learn and Grow: Stay ahead of emerging networking technologies and trends, continuously enhancing your skills and contributing to innovation.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Technical Expertise: **Strong foundation in routing, switching, VPN, SD-WAN/SASE, and data center networking** . **Deep knowledge of Aruba technologies including Aruba Central, Access Points, Switches, Gateways, ClearPass, and UXI.**
* Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to analyze complex issues, think critically, and deliver effective solutions under pressure.
* Continuous Learner: Passion for staying updated with the latest networking advancements and applying them to improve performance.
* Collaborative Communicator: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively across teams.
* Qualifications: **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, 3+ years of network engineering experience** , Aruba certifications (ACCP, ACSP, ACCX), and familiarity with **ITIL** frameworks.

**What You'll Get from Us**
---------------------------

At Danfoss, we believe in empowering growth and innovation. You will:

* Join a global, forward-thinking organization committed to sustainability and cutting-edge technology.
* Work in a dynamic environment where your ideas matter and your contributions drive real impact.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and advanced training to accelerate your career.
* Be part of a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and adaptability, helping you unlock your full potential.
* Enjoy a supportive workplace that encourages you to challenge the status quo, learn from experiences, and grow every day.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
-------------------------------

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Development Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Development Support Engineer**

**Department: IT**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Development Support Engineer to provide day-to-day support across the software development lifecycle. You will triage and reproduce incoming issues, fix defects in existing services, assist with testing and deployments, and take on small development tasks under the guidance of senior engineers. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for someone with a solid programming foundation who wants to grow into a full backend or full-stack engineering position. You will learn our platforms end-to-end, gain exposure to cutting-edge technology including AI-assisted development tooling and AI-driven product features, and act as the first line of technical response for the systems we run.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Triage, reproduce, and document incoming bug reports and escalations from internal teams and customers.

* Fix low- to medium-complexity defects in existing services and applications with guidance from senior engineers.

* Take on routine development tasks, including small feature enhancements, configuration changes, and code cleanup.

* Support build, release, and deployment activities across development, staging, and production environments.

* Monitor application logs, dashboards, and alerts, and escalate issues with clear diagnostic detail.

* Prepare test data, environment setups, and sandbox instances for the development team.

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues.

* Participate in code reviews, stand-ups, and sprint ceremonies to build familiarity with team standards and practices.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.

**Work Experience:**

* 2 years of experience in software development, technical support, or a related technical role.

* Experience on projects demonstrating hands-on coding will be considered.

* Exposure to a team development workflow using version control and issue tracking is an advantage.

**Technical Skills Required:**

* Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose programming language — C#, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.

* Understanding of object-oriented programming fundamentals and the habits behind clean, readable code.

* Basic SQL and relational database concepts — queries, joins, and reading an existing schema.

* Familiarity with REST APIs and tools such as Postman or Swagger.

* Git fundamentals: branching, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.

* Comfortable on both Windows and Linux, including basic command-line usage.

* Ability to read logs, stack traces, and error messages to isolate a problem.

* Familiarity with issue tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Exposure to .NET (C#) or Node.js/TypeScript backend development.

* Basic understanding of containers and Docker.

* Awareness of CI/CD concepts and automated build pipelines.

* Fundamental exposure to a cloud platform, AWS or Azure.

* Automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, Jest, or Vitest.

* Interest in monitoring and observability tooling: dashboards, log aggregation, and alerting.

* Basic scripting for repetitive tasks.

**Soft Skills:**

* Eager to learn, comfortable asking questions, and receptive to feedback from senior engineers.

* Methodical and patient when investigating problems, and sees an issue through to resolution.

* Clear written communication when documenting issues, steps to reproduce, and fixes applied.

* Dependable follow-through on small tasks and commitments without needing reminders.

* Collaborative, working comfortably alongside developers, QA, and support teams.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Energy Resource Manager (ERM)
description:
**Overview**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as an Energy Resource Manager (ERM) with the primary focus at reducing stranded capacity applying optimization techniques of space, power, cooling and network. Being a key member of the local Datacenter Operations team in the deployment planning and optimization of the IT capacity, working closely with Electrical Engineers and Critical Environment Field Service Engineer.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I ERM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. By enabling data center capacity through increased Infrastructure Utilization Effectiveness (IUE) and Power Harvesting (PH), you will lead the retrofit efforts to upgrade legacy datacenters and harvest capacity in our existing fleet. As a group, CO+I is focused on personal and professional development for all employees, offer trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

* Primary focus in Managing IT Allocation at the Campus/Metro level by collaborating with key stakeholders and ensuring that demands are properly allocated across the IT infrastructure.
* Familiarize with the Data Center design and manage the IT resources by performing virtual failure analysis and develop a master allocation plan to drive the operationalization of the customer capacity.
* Ensure compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
* Engage with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
* Manage programs associated with the area of responsibility.
* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
* Raise risks to the IT capacity allocation and planning. Identify power stranding and contractual inconsistencies (leased spaces).
* Ensure that the critical environment information is properly entered and maintained (tooling).
* Lead programs and projects through leadership forums aligning scope, schedule, and cost that align to our OKRs.

Service Delivery

* Manage the assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives and escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
* Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.

Data Center Work Environment

* Share best practices; assist others in learning role, process, procedures.
* Collaborate and engage with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across CO+I and engineering groups to gain program / project insights.
* Leverage and synthesize these insights to develop and operationalize solutions that mitigate our customer gaps.
* Provide mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
* Seek training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.
* Suggest ways of reducing risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
* Suggest improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding.
* Contribute to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices.
* Contribute constructively during team meetings and in cross-discipline collaborations within the service team.
* Recognize priority of team success over individual achievement.
* Collaborate and negotiate effectively with others and seek guidance from management to identify delegates to deliver results.

Ownership

* In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Other · Embody our Microsoft One culture and values.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelores in Electrical Engineering or equivalent AND 3+ years’ experience supporting critical service infrastructure operation, maintenance, projects in large-scale OR equivalent experience.
* Fluency in English language skills.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* 5+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructure (e.g., UPS, PDUs, Generators, AHU/CFM, ability to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and working with IT infrastructure modifications (e.g., Cable trays, Fiber Runners, HACs and IT equipment).
* 1+ years’ experience working within a Datacenter environment, focusing on Capacity and Planning or Energy Resource
* 1+ years’ experience in IT Critical Space and understanding of IT Allocation (e.g., Diverse Cluster density, quanta, patterns)

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Sr Manager - Program Management
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

1. Material Cost Management
  

* Establish and monitor material cost targets for all programs.
* Drive BOM cost tracking from concept through production.
* Track cost changes arising from design modifications, sourcing decisions, and engineering change requests.
* Identify material cost gaps and lead cost recovery actions.
* Support value engineering and cost optimization initiatives to achieve target costs.

2. Budget Planning & Financial Control
  

* Develop, monitor, and maintain program budgets.
* Track engineering, tooling, prototype, testing, validation, and launch expenditures.
* Monitor actual spend versus approved budgets and forecasts.
* Lead monthly financial reviews and budget performance assessments.
* Ensure timely identification of budget overruns and implementation of corrective actions.
* Maintain program financial forecasts and budget outlooks.

* Lead and manage a team of 4 members responsible for material cost and budget tracking activities.

10

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery**

* Partner with Databricks and platform teams to transition existing pipelines into the target enterprise data platform.
* Provide hands-on engineering support to stabilize and optimize pipelines post-transition, focusing on performance, scalability, maintainability, and operational reliability.
* Implement and follow repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.

* Work with lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, and support metadata-driven pipeline design.

**Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement**

* Support asset-agnostic onboarding by applying standard ingestion and transformation frameworks to new datasets.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding standards, delivery practices, and technical templates.
* Contribute to reusable technical assets such as reference implementations, onboarding templates, documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Support both batch and streaming onboarding patterns using AWS services (e.g., AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis) or event-driven integrations as appropriate.

**Data Mastering Platform Integration**

* Support integration of platform datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Help establish and/or maintain data quality controls, reconciliation, and metadata alignment for trusted mastered data.
* Support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance activities for key financial datasets (as applicable to the program).

**Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical guidance to engineering peers through code reviews, design reviews, and implementation planning.
* Contribute to engineering standards and delivery rigor across CI/CD, infrastructure automation, testing practices, and operational readiness.
* Help ensure documentation quality and operational discipline (runbooks, support procedures, incident learnings).
* Act as a technical bridge between offshore execution teams and global platform stakeholders to resolve delivery blockers and keep alignment.

**AI-Assisted Engineering and Context Engineering**

* Use AI tools (Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs) to accelerate engineering tasks such as drafting code, refactoring, writing documentation, generating unit tests, and troubleshooting.
* Apply basic prompt engineering and context engineering practices by providing the right technical background, constraints, schemas, examples, and acceptance criteria to improve output quality.
* Validate and verify AI-generated outputs before adoption, especially for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Follow responsible AI usage expectations, including protection of sensitive data, credentials, and regulated information.

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Experience**

* 5–7+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related technical domains.
* Hands-on experience building and operating batch and/or streaming data pipelines.
* Experience working with Databricks-based platforms and lakehouse architectures.
* Strong familiarity with AWS data engineering services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Kinesis, and AWS IAM.
* Working knowledge of Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog (or equivalent governed lakehouse concepts).
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage/metadata basics, access control, encryption, and operational support.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Ability to provide technical guidance without people management responsibility.
* Experience collaborating with global teams across time zones and working through ambiguous delivery problems.
* Strong communication skills and ability to translate technical requirements into implementable tasks.

**AI Tooling (Required)**

* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, or LLM-based development features.
* Ability to use AI effectively with basic context engineering practices (inputs/constraints/examples/acceptance criteria).
* Demonstrated ability to validate AI-generated outputs and follow responsible, secure usage practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise onboarding frameworks, reusable ingestion patterns, and pipeline templates.
* Familiarity with data cataloging/metadata management and governed data product concepts.
* Knowledge of semantic modeling (e.g., semantic layers, business definitions, canonical models) is a plus.
* Exposure to enterprise data mastering/MDM workflows, golden record concepts, and trusted data distribution.
* Experience in regulated environments with strong governance, auditability, and security expectations.
* Databricks and/or AWS certifications (or equivalent practical experience) are a plus.

title: Lead I - Product Architect
description:
**Role description**

Data Architect Role Overview The Data Architect will define and own end-to-end data architecture for AI initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes the data models, platform patterns, governance, and operational standards needed to support ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and retrieval. Working with business stakeholders, AI specialists, platform engineers, and data engineers, the Data Architect will translate business needs into scalable data foundations and clear architectural direction. Key Responsibilities Data architecture and modeling: Own the architecture across BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage, and related services. Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, including domain boundaries, partitioning, indexing, and schema evolution. Pipeline architecture: Establish reference architectures and reusable design patterns for batch and streaming pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. AI-ready data foundations: Design data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and hybrid search, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding pipelines, vector storage using pgvector/ScaNN, and refresh and re-indexing patterns. Large language model integration and evaluation: Define standards for integrating large language model (LLM) APIs, including Vertex AI/Gemini and other providers, into extraction, classification, summarization, and enrichment workflows. Balance quality, cost, latency, and security. Partner with quality assurance (QA) to design evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, sampling, human review, regression testing, and ongoing measurement of accuracy, consistency, cost, and latency. Governance and data quality: Establish validation, cataloging, and lineage architecture, including tools such as Dataplex. Define standards for personally identifiable information (PII), retention, access controls, and auditability. Reliability and operations: Set service-level agreement (SLA) and service-level objective (SLO) standards, monitoring, ing, idempotency, backfills, failure handling, and incident response. Lead architectural root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Technology strategy: Evaluate data technologies and platforms, document trade-offs, and guide build-versus-buy decisions, cost optimization, and scalability planning. Support integration with hybrid-cloud and legacy systems, including Azure-based data services where applicable. Cross-functional architecture: Partner with the AI Architect and AI Engineer to support retrieval and agent solutions through sound data design. Work with the Platform Engineer on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code, and environment standards for data workloads. Technical leadership: Mentor Data Engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and guide complex implementations. Translate business needs and data domains into architectural roadmaps, and produce clear architecture documentation and decision records for technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications and Technical Expertise Experience designing end-to-end cloud data architectures, with expertise in GCP data services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, and Cloud Storage. Strong conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling skills, including schema evolution, partitioning, indexing, and domain design. Experience defining batch and streaming pipeline patterns using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Experience designing data foundations for RAG, semantic and hybrid search, embedding pipelines, vector storage, and LLM-enabled workflows. Ability to define data quality, governance, lineage, security, retention, and access-control standards, alongside evaluation approaches for AI-enabled data use cases. Knowledge of data-platform reliability, monitoring, failure recovery, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to evaluate scalability, cost, and operational trade-offs. Ability to lead architectural decisions, mentor Data Engineers, collaborate across business and engineering teams, and communicate technical direction through clear documentation and roadmaps. Familiarity with hybrid-cloud and legacy-system integration, including Azure-based data services where applicable.

title: Connectivity Validation Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

For Caterpillar, Connectivity means using technology to extract data from our machines and engines and transform it into valuable recommendations and insights to help customers make better, more informed decisions and help Caterpillar make robust products with the lowest total ownership cost. Our products generate and process large amounts of data from sensors, on-board models, and control algorithms in real-time, creating real-world machine usage information to provide condition monitoring and fleet management services.

**Job Description**

Caterpillar’s **Connectivity Systems team – Cat Technology Division** is currently seeking an **Electronic Systems Verification and Validation Engineer** to support the End-to-End Connectivity Validation team.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership in defining and executing **validation strategies** for complex connected products across onboard machine/engine systems, embedded software, connectivity, and back-office systems. You will drive **Shift Left validation** by expanding the use of simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL), test automation, and other advanced validation methods to identify issues earlier in the product development lifecycle.

You will be part of a global engineering team working closely with Systems, Software, Hardware, and Product teams to define validation strategies, develop **DVP&R**, conduct release validation, automate testing, troubleshoot complex issues, and continuously advance Caterpillar’s validation capabilities.

**What You Will Do:**

The primary function of this role is to apply **engineering principles and technical leadership** to the verification and validation of embedded and connected systems that enable Caterpillar telematics products.

* Define **validation strategies and own DVP&R** based on product requirements, architecture, customer use cases, and technical risks.
* Determine appropriate **validation coverage** across SIL, HIL bench, system, machine, and End-to-End environments.
* Develop **validation plans, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and requirements-to-test traceability**.
* Lead system integration and End-to-End validation across embedded hardware/software, connectivity, and back-office interfaces.
* Develop and expand **automated regression and continuous validation** capabilities to improve **test coverage and efficiency**.
* Analyse test results**, troubleshoot** complex system issues, and drive **root-cause analysis** and issue resolution.
* Introduce new validation approaches, **simulation capabilities, automation frameworks**, and **AI-assisted methods** to improve quality and productivity.
* Champion **Shift Left validation** using simulation, SIL, virtual environments, and automation to identify defects earlier in the development cycle.
* Influence product requirements and design to improve testability, diagnosability, reliability, and robustness.
* Provide **technical guidance and mentoring** to engineers and communicate **validation status, technical risks, and release readiness** to stakeholders.

**What You Have (Basic Requirements):**

**Education Requirement:**

* Degree or advanced degree in an accredited Engineering curriculum in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 9-12 years related experience.

**Technical Excellence:**

* Strong working knowledge of embedded and connected systems and the ability to provide solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Ability to define validation strategies and provide technical leadership across multiple levels of product validation.
* Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

**Product Testing:**

* Excellent working knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques, and tools; ability to design, plan, and execute End-to-End system validation.
* Experience developing DVP&R, validation plans, test coverage, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability.
* Experience with SiL, HiL, simulation, system integration, regression, and release validation.
* Ability to evaluate and introduce new test environments, tools, and validation methods.

**Analytical Thinking:**

* Strong knowledge of data analysis and diagnostic techniques to interpret complex test results and system behavior.
* Ability to break down complex system problems, identify potential root causes, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Ability to use validation evidence and engineering judgement to assess product risk and readiness.
* Applies lessons learned to improve future validation coverage and prevent issue recurrence.

**Effective Communications:**

* Collaborative team player with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Clearly communicates technical information, validation findings, risks, and recommendations across diverse teams.
* Effectively presents and reviews validation strategies, results, and technical issues with process partners and leadership.
* Provides technical guidance, constructive feedback, and coaching to other engineers.

**Top Candidates Will Have:**

* Demonstrated experience defining validation strategies and DVP&R for embedded or connected products.
* Strong experience with embedded systems, system integration, and End-to-End validation.
* Experience with connectivity technologies such as CAN/J1939, Ethernet, Cellular/4G/5G, GNSS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and MQTT.
* Strong experience with Python scripting and automated test frameworks.
* Experience with dSPACE tools such as VEOS, ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, or equivalent SiL/HiL environments.
* Experience developing or enhancing test benches, simulators, and validation infrastructure.
* Experience with CI/CD or continuous validation practices.
* Practical experience applying AI/GenAI to engineering or validation workflows is an advantage.
* Strong ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and system integration issues.

title: Sr. Director, Security Engineering
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

The Senior Director, Product Security & PSIRT, will lead large-enterprise product security programs across Gigamon’s hardware and software portfolio. This role will set the strategic direction for the PSIRT team, chair the PSIRT Steering Committee, and partner with VP and executive leadership to drive timely, risk-based decisions. Serving as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, the leader will establish consistent, repeatable practices for vulnerability research, testing, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base content, and coordinated disclosure. They will also develop Gigamon’s product red-team framework, evaluate appropriate security tools, and advise the CISO on the evolving product security tool landscape.

**What you’ll do**

* Set the strategic direction, priorities, and operating model for Gigamon’s Product Security and PSIRT programs.

title: Software Principal Engineer - SONiC Community & System Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – SONiC Community & System Validation**  
  
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will represent Dell System Test Engineering in the SONiC open-source community, advancing SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions through validation and upstream contributions. You will work with SONiC maintainers, developers, platform partners, and engineering teams to improve feature quality, testability, and solution readiness. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, passionate engineer who independently drives and defends technical positions backed by data, and strengthens Dell’s technical presence across the SONiC ecosystem.

**You will:**

* Represent Dell System Test Engineering in SONiC working groups, technical forums, design reviews, and community initiatives, influencing SONiC community discussions with data and validation results.
* Contribute validation expertise, automation, and test infrastructure to the SONiC ecosystem, and review specifications, RFCs, design proposals, and roadmaps from a validation and customer deployment perspective, with test plans aligned to spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD).
* Validate SONiC features across functional, scale, interoperability, resiliency, and lossless-fabric scenarios, including link-level retransmission (LLR) and retransmit behavior.
* Analyze complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive triage and closure with engineering and community contributors, using Python and SpyTest test strategies, automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.
* Advocate best practices in system testing, automation, observability, and quality engineering, grounding every recommendation in data, quality, and customer impact.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* SONiC and open networking: strong knowledge of SONiC architecture and open, disaggregated networking across AI, data center, and enterprise solutions, with extensive system validation across VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, Layer 2, multicast, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Community leadership: experience in open-source communities, technical forums, or standards bodies, with strong technical leadership and communication skills to independently drive and defend technical positions using data.
* Lossless fabric validation: RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, latency, performance, and resiliency across scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale networking and compute environments.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with CI/CD workflows, traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), packet analysis, telemetry, and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Hands-on SpyTest and scalable network test automation, with experience in server and storage infrastructure or fabric orchestration solutions.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for test development, automation, analysis, specification reviews, and open-source contributions.

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here .

This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.

**What you’ll be doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.

* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.

description:

You will work closely with business stakeholders, risk teams, auditors, cyber security teams, and technology delivery functions to ensure effective control execution, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and continuous process improvement. Strong stakeholder management, communication, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently across cross-functional teams.

* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or equivalent audit, governance, risk, or compliance certification preferred.
* Experience supporting governance, risk, and controls activities within Workday environments, including ERP transformation and operational governance initiatives.
* Experience working in SOX-regulated, highly regulated, or compliance-driven organizations with strong audit and controls requirements.

With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Architect I - Software Testing- Facets + Playwright Automation
description:
**Role description**

We are seeking a highly experienced **Automation Architect** to define and drive the organization’s enterprise test automation strategy, with **Playwright** as the primary framework for modern web automation.

The ideal candidate will architect, govern, and implement scalable automation solutions across **web applications, APIs, databases, batch processes, and end-to-end business workflows**, including applications within the **TriZetto Facets healthcare payer ecosystem**.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for defining automation roadmaps, establishing enterprise frameworks and engineering standards, identifying high-value automation opportunities, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and building sustainable automation capabilities that improve software quality, accelerate releases, and reduce manual testing effort.

Key Responsibilities

### **Automation Strategy & Architecture**

* Define and execute the enterprise **test automation vision, roadmap, and target-state architecture**.
* Establish **Playwright** as a strategic automation framework for modern web applications.
* Design scalable and reusable automation architecture covering **web, API, database, batch, and end-to-end testing**.
* Establish automation governance, coding standards, design principles, framework guidelines, and engineering best practices across delivery teams.
* Conduct automation assessments and identify high-value candidates based on business criticality, execution frequency, complexity, maintainability, and ROI.
* Define a unified automation approach for business processes spanning multiple applications and integration layers.
* Establish strategies for **test-data management, environment management, execution orchestration, reporting, and defect diagnostics**.

### **Playwright Automation**

* Architect and develop enterprise-grade **Playwright frameworks using TypeScript or JavaScript**.
* Implement framework patterns including **Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable components, utilities, configuration management, and data-driven testing**.
* Design automation supporting **cross-browser, parallel, UI, and API testing**.
* Automate member, provider, customer service, and other enterprise portals within the healthcare payer ecosystem.
* Implement robust handling of **dynamic elements, synchronization, waits, authentication, test data, retry mechanisms, and flaky tests**.
* Leverage Playwright capabilities such as **traces, screenshots, videos, reporting, network interception, API testing, and parallel execution** for efficient execution and defect analysis.
* Mentor automation engineers and QA teams on Playwright architecture, framework development, coding standards, and troubleshooting practices.

### **API & Integration Automation**

* Define enterprise-level **API automation strategy and architecture**.
* Build reusable automation for REST-based services and application integrations.
* Design automated validation across **UI, API, database, EDI, and batch processing layers**.
* Establish strategies for service-level validation, test-data setup, response validation, negative testing, and integration testing.
* Design end-to-end automated workflows that validate business transactions across multiple systems.
* Integrate API automation with Playwright and other enterprise automation frameworks where appropriate.

### **CI/CD & Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and/or GitHub Actions**.
* Define automation execution strategies across pull requests, continuous integration, regression, release, and scheduled pipelines.
* Enable parallel and distributed execution to improve feedback time.
* Establish automated reporting and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines.
* Track framework and execution metrics including **pass rates, flaky-test rates, execution duration, automation coverage, defect detection, and pipeline stability**.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement **shift-left and continuous testing practices**.

### **Solution Design & Delivery**

* Architect end-to-end automation solutions covering **web, API, database, EDI, and batch validation**.
* Evaluate automation technologies and recommend appropriate tools based on application architecture, scalability, maintainability, integration capability, and total cost of ownership.
* Ensure automation platforms meet enterprise requirements for **security, scalability, maintainability, reliability, compliance, and operational sustainability**.
* Define secure test-data management practices appropriate for **HIPAA-regulated healthcare environments**.
* Provide technical leadership throughout framework design, implementation, deployment, migration, and ongoing modernization.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical reviews of automation solutions developed across delivery teams.

### **Automation CoE & Governance**

* Establish and lead an **Automation Center of Excellence (CoE)**.
* Define enterprise automation standards, reusable assets, reference architectures, framework templates, and governance processes.
* Establish technical review and framework onboarding processes for project teams.
* Develop reusable automation accelerators to improve delivery efficiency across programs.
* Define appropriate KPIs for evaluating automation maturity and effectiveness.
* Drive framework adoption and standardization across multiple products and delivery teams.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with QA leadership, product teams, business stakeholders, developers, enterprise architects, DevOps, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and delivery teams.
* Present **automation strategies, architecture proposals, investment requirements, business cases, ROI, and roadmaps** to senior leadership.
* Translate business priorities into practical automation strategies.
* Manage technical engagements with automation vendors and strategic partners.
* Influence engineering teams to adopt common quality-engineering and automation practices.

### **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of **Generative AI** for areas such as test-case design, automation script generation, code optimization, test-data generation, failure analysis, and self-healing automation.
* Evaluate emerging automation technologies, AI-assisted testing capabilities, and quality-engineering practices.
* Continuously improve framework performance, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Monitor automation coverage, stability, execution trends, productivity improvements, ROI, and benefits realization.

  
**Skills**

API Testing, Playwright, FACETS, Test Automation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Generative AI, JavaScript, Robotic Process Automation, SQL

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We build an AI-powered application security platform. It reads source code, finds security vulnerabilities, and then produces a fix that a person reviews and approves. Customers install it and run it inside their own cloud environment. The stack is Python (Langgraph, FastAPI, Pydantic V2), TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms.

**About the role**
------------------

You'll be the senior engineering owner of the backend platform, and the person everyone else learns the system from. Your job is to spread the knowledge across a team and lift engineering quality as that team grows.

The core backend service runs the analysis and remediation workflow. It's long-running and resumable, it pauses for human decisions, and it has to survive restarts without losing state.

You'll be our first engineering hire and the person who can deploy and debug the whole system. You'll also review everyone's code. Reviewing senior work and disagreeing with it is part of the job, not a rare exception.

You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Playwright is used for reliable end-to-end web testing and supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, with capabilities such as auto-waiting, assertions, parallel execution, tracing, and test isolation.

  
  

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain automated UI and end-to-end test suites using Playwright.

Create reusable test frameworks using TypeScript/JavaScript and Playwright Test.

Automate functional, regression, smoke, integration, and cross-browser testing.

Develop reliable locators using approaches such as roles, labels, test IDs, and other resilient selectors.

Implement assertions, fixtures, hooks, reusable utilities, and Page Object Model (POM) patterns.

Execute automated tests across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers.

Implement parallel execution and test isolation to improve test-suite reliability and execution time.

Debug automation failures using screenshots, videos, logs, reports, and Playwright Trace Viewer.

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

Perform API testing and combine API validation with UI automation where appropriate.

Analyze failed and flaky tests, identify root causes, and improve automation stability.

Work closely with developers, QA engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders.

Participate in test planning, test-case reviews, defect management, and release validation.

Must-have

Playwright

TypeScript / JavaScript

Web UI automation

End-to-end testing

Functional and regression testing

Cross-browser testing

Playwright locators

Assertions and auto-waiting

Fixtures and hooks

Page Object Model

Test data management

API testing

HTML test reports

Trace Viewer / debugging

Git / source control

CI/CD.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember. In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence. What you will do Analyze and Solve •Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes •Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities •Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability •Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions Design and Integrate •Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies •Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation •Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors •Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity Collaborate and Deliver •Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians •Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines •Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders •Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results Grow and Advance •Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies •Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects •Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**  
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

### **Role Definition**

Own and evolve the end-to-end technical architecture for the platform ecosystem, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, integrated, resilient, cost-effective, and operationally reliable.

Define architecture across applications, cloud platforms, data, APIs, integrations, and shared platform capabilities, translating business and product needs into implementable designs and engineering standards. Create HLDs and architecture patterns, guide LLDs, and ensure architectural decisions are successfully translated into working solutions.

This is a **hands-on architecture and engineering role**. The System Architect will actively contribute to software development, including production code, reference implementations, technical prototypes, code reviews, and complex feature delivery.

The role remains technically accountable through production, **leading diagnosis of complex cross-system issues** and driving architectural and engineering improvements through resolution and stabilisation.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end architecture across application, platform, data, and integration layers
* Create HLDs, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and key technical designs
* Guide LLDs and ensure implementations remain aligned with architectural intent
* Define standards for APIs, microservices, data flows, identity, integration, and cloud-native solutions
* Make technical trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and cloud cost

### **Hands-On Engineering & Development**

* Actively participate in software development and complex feature implementation
* Write, debug, test, and review production-quality code
* Build prototypes, reference implementations, reusable components, and technical accelerators
* Participate in code and design reviews and improve engineering quality and maintainability
* Validate architectural decisions through working software, testing, and production evidence

### **Platform & Cloud Engineering**

* Design distributed and cloud-native solutions across AWS and Azure
* Establish reusable capabilities for identity, integration, environments, containerisation, CI/CD, and microservices
* Guide application modernisation and cloud adoption
* Design for high availability, resilience, scalability, security, and cost efficiency
* Reduce project-specific solutions through reusable platform services and engineering patterns

### **Production Reliability & Technical Problem Solving**

* Define observability across logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, dashboards, and alerting
* **Lead diagnosis of complex cross-system production issues**, working directly with code, telemetry, configuration, integrations, and infrastructure to identify root cause
* Drive technical resolution through implementation and stabilisation
* Address recurring issues through architectural and engineering improvements
* Ensure systems are secure, observable, supportable, and production-ready

### **Technical Leadership & Governance**

* Establish architecture and engineering standards across teams
* Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance
* Evaluate technologies and frameworks based on engineering value, risk, cost, and long-term sustainability
* Partner with Product, Security, Data, DevOps, Product Support, and Engineering teams while retaining architectural accountability

### **Skill Descriptors**

### **System & Cloud Architecture (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs complex distributed and cloud-native systems across AWS and Azure
* Defines application, **data and database architecture**, including data flows, storage patterns, schemas, performance, and scalability
* Applies **security-by-design**, including identity, access, service security, certificates, and secure architecture patterns
* Makes effective trade-offs across scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost

### **Hands-On Software Engineering (Extensive Experience)**

* Strong hands-on software development capability, preferably Java
* Writes, tests, debugs, reviews, maintains, and troubleshoots production software
* Builds APIs, services, prototypes, reference implementations, and reusable components
* Translates architectural decisions into working production implementations
* Diagnoses difficult problems spanning application and platform boundaries

### **Platform, Integration & DevOps (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and reusable platform capabilities
* Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, environment management, and modern DevOps practices
* Designs resilient integrations with clear service contracts, dependencies, and failure handling
* Applies platform engineering principles to reduce duplication and accelerate product delivery
* Understands database, real-time data processing, messaging, and distributed-system patterns

### **Production Engineering & Technical Leadership (Extensive Experience)**

* Designs for observability, high availability, resilience, recovery, and operational support
* Leads root-cause diagnosis of complex production and performance issues
* Uses logs, metrics, traces, application behaviour, code, and infrastructure evidence to drive technical decisions
* Leads through technical depth, working implementations, engineering standards, and mentoring
* Drives systemic improvements following production failures rather than treating incidents as isolated events

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
