* Strong hands-on Java development experience
* Production experience designing/ implementing cloud-native systems on AWS/ Azure
* Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data/integration patterns, and production troubleshooting

title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team.  
In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production.

* **Cloud Platform Engineering:** Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads.
* **AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines:** Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
* **Containerization & Orchestration:** Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads.
* **Observability & Reliability:** Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production.
* **Security & Governance:** Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* **Developer Enablement:** Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production.  
    
  **Skills Knowledge Required**
  + **Cloud Platform:** Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
  + **DevOps / SRE Practices:** Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging.
  + **AI-Ops / LLMOps:** Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs.
  + **Scripting & Automation:** Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators.
  + **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably.
  + **Security & Compliance:** Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments.
  + **Analytics Workflow Understanding:** Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them.
* **Qualifications Experience**
  + **Education:** Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  + **DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience:** 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
  + **AI/MLOps Engineering:** Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE).
  + **Automation & Reliability:** Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems.
  + **Good to Have (Optional)::** Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).

title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers.

  

***First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time.***

***Division:***

  

EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.

description:

**About Us**
------------

Infoya is a global IT solutions provider specializing in transforming complex challenges into streamlined, AI-powered outcomes. Through proprietary technology accelerators and full-scale enterprise services, Infoya automates workflows, enhances operational efficiency, and drives digital transformation across industries. With a presence in Canada, the US, India, and Costa Rica, we blend technical depth with creative problem-solving to deliver measurable impact.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description – Senior QA Engineer (Automation, Data & ETL Testing)**

**Position:** Senior Automation Engineer – Data & ETL Testing
  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years

**About the Role**

Infoya is looking for an experienced **Senior Automation Engineer** with strong expertise in test automation , database testing, ETL validation, and data pipeline testing. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with cloud-based data platforms, complex data architectures, and business intelligence solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring data accuracy, integrity, consistency, reliability, and performance across enterprise data pipelines and analytical platforms.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Test Automation (Mandatory)**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks for database, ETL, and data pipeline validation.
* Develop reusable automated test scripts using Python, SQL, or equivalent technologies.
* Automate source-to-target reconciliation, data quality checks, schema validation, and regression testing.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and overall QA productivity through automation  

**2. Database Testing & Data Validation**

* Design and execute comprehensive database testing strategies for complex enterprise applications.
* Perform advanced SQL-based validation, including complex joins, aggregations, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Validate data integrity, completeness, accuracy, and consistency across source and target systems.
* Conduct backend testing using PostgreSQL and StarRocks.
Identify data quality issues, transformation defects, and performance bottlenecks.  

**3. ETL & Data Pipeline Testing**

* Validate end-to-end ETL/ELT workflows, including data extraction, transformation, loading, and reconciliation.
* Test batch and streaming data pipelines for accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
* Validate transformation rules, data mappings, business logic, and aggregation calculations.
* Perform incremental load, full load, duplicate detection, and data consistency testing.
Verify error handling, recovery mechanisms, and data pipeline dependencies.  

**4. Cloud & Data Platform Testing**

* Work with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to validate cloud-based data processing and storage solutions.
* Perform data validation across PostgreSQL, StarRocks, and other enterprise data platforms.
* Test data ingestion, processing, transformation, and integration workflows.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Developers to troubleshoot data-related issues.  

**5. Business Intelligence & Reporting Validation**

* Validate Tableau dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical outputs.
* Reconcile dashboard data against underlying databases and source systems.
* Verify business rules, filters, aggregations, calculations, and reporting accuracy.
Ensure consistency between analytical data layers and business reporting.  

**6. Performance Testing (Good to have knowledge)**

* Perform database query performance testing and optimization validation.
* Evaluate ETL pipeline throughput, processing latency, and scalability.
* Support load, stress, and volume testing for data-intensive applications.
Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with engineering teams on improvements.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, with significant hands-on experience in database and ETL testing.
* Strong experience in developing automated test scripts and reusable testing frameworks.
* Excellent SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, joins, aggregations, and data validation.
* Practical experience with PostgreSQL, StarRocks, Tableau, and GCP.
* Knowledge with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer.
* Proven experience validating end-to-end data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data quality principles.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.  

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Performance testing experience for databases and large-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with PyTest, Great Expectations, dbt testing, or similar data quality automation tools.
* Experience testing large-volume datasets and near-real-time data processing.
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud-native testing practices.  

  

**Expected Outcomes**

The successful candidate will:

* Establish robust automated testing coverage across critical data pipelines.
* Improve data quality and reduce production data defects.
* Strengthen end-to-end validation across source systems, databases, and Tableau reporting.
* Accelerate regression testing through automation and reusable frameworks.
Collaborate proactively with engineering teams to improve the reliability and scalability of enterprise data platforms.  

  

**Ideal Candidate:** A technically strong, hands-on Senior QA Engineer who combines advanced SQL and database testing expertise with automation-first thinking, ETL/data pipeline validation experience, and practical exposure to modern cloud data platforms.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.
  
  
Role Summary:  
As Lead Data Engineer, you'll lead projects within OneMagnify's data engineering team end-to-end — staying hands-on in design, architecture, and standards rather than handing them off. It's roughly 60% leadership, 40% technical build. You'll work closely with strategy and analytics to keep the data layer behind our client work fast, reliable, and built to scale.

**The Impact You'll Have**
--------------------------

The platforms you build power what OneMagnify's enterprise clients can do with their data — real-time personalization, customer segmentation, and the clean foundation analytics teams need for advanced modeling. When a client wants cross-channel marketing that responds to customer behavior in the moment, your architecture makes that possible.

You'll be the technical anchor connecting data engineering with analytics, creative, and strategy on complex projects — the coordination that OneMagnify's integrated delivery model depends on. Along the way, you're setting the technical bar: modern architecture patterns, tighter workflows, and platforms that stay secure and aligned with where clients are headed.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Lead Projects End-to-End**

* Lead data engineering projects from the ground up, owning design and architecture decisions
* Set the engineering standards the team builds against — and hold your own work to the same bar
* Stay hands-on in the code on key projects, mentoring engineers through reviews and pairing

**Architect and Build Data Infrastructure**
-------------------------------------------

* Design and implement ETL/ELT pipelines that hold up under real production load
* Build advanced database solutions in Oracle Cloud Database and PostgreSQL — database architecture, query refinement, stored procedures
* Develop cloud-native data solutions on Google Cloud Platform that scale with client demand

**Raise the Engineering Bar**
-----------------------------

* Set the standard for maintainability, testing, and documentation, and own resolution of the hardest technical problems
* Bring CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code into delivery, working alongside DevOps to keep releases fast and clean
* Monitor system performance and get ahead of issues before clients see them

**Own Delivery**
----------------

* Run sprint planning and manage timelines so complex projects land on time and at quality
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering, operations, and client-facing teams
* Weigh in on hiring and onboarding decisions as the team scales

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 7+ years in data engineering, database development, or a related technical subject area
* 3+ years leading or managing engineering teams, proven in mentoring engineers and delivering results
* Deep expertise in Oracle’s cloud-based database systems development, including PL/SQL, performance tuning, and cloud-native features
* Advanced PostgreSQL skills — schema design, query tuning, indexing, and database administration
* Hands-on experience with various services within Google's cloud ecosystem such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or Cloud Composer
* Strong Python and SQL, with a track record of writing clean, production-quality code
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development
* Strong problem-solving instincts for complex, multi-source data environments
* Clear communicator who can work across technical and non-technical teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience

**Future-Ready Skills (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with Azure services (Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL Database, Data Lake Storage)
* Hands-on work with Databricks for data processing, analytics, or machine learning workflows
* Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows and tools for data quality, observability, or automated pipeline generation

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and operate data platform components and data-intensive products. You will own significant data engineering work from requirements and design through implementation and production support, partnering with Data Engineering, Data Science, Cloud, DevOps, Application, Product, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable solutions that support business growth.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who can solve distributed-data challenges, contribute to sound technical decisions, support other engineers, and help bring emerging technologies into reliable production capabilities.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, platform components, and data-intensive services.
* Own data engineering work from requirements and technical design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Contribute to data acquisition strategies, dataset contracts, acceptance criteria, quality standards, lineage, and lifecycle policies.
* Build scalable batch and real-time data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and distributed processing solutions for high-volume workloads.
* Help evolve the data ecosystem to support growth in data volume, velocity, variety, and product complexity.
* Apply and improve reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration, testing, observability, and delivery.
* Build production systems that meet expectations for reliability, security, performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and SLA-driven delivery.
* Contribute to operational practices for monitoring, incident response, failure recovery, replay, backfills, schema evolution, and disaster recovery.
* Partner with Data Science and ML teams to productionize ML, AI, and LLM-based workloads and integrate them into customer-facing products.
* Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Application, Security, Product, and client teams to deliver robust solutions for business and customer needs.
* Evaluate technologies and architectural patterns, contribute to technical proofs of concept, and recommend adoption based on measurable value.
* Document technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation approaches.
* Participate in technical reviews and help improve design, code quality, testing, maintainability, and production ownership.
* Support engineering roadmaps, hiring, and capability development across the data engineering discipline.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **6+ years of hands-on software or data engineering experience, including experience designing, building, and operating production-grade data systems.**
* Experience contributing to complex data initiatives across teams.
* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or comparable practical experience.
* Strong understanding of data-intensive and **distributed systems**, including scalability, reliability, consistency, and performance trade-offs.
* **Strong proficiency in Python and working proficiency in Scala.**
* **Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.**
* Experience with large-scale data processing technologies such as **Apache Spark and Databricks.**
* Experience designing and operating event-driven or **streaming systems** using technologies such as Apache Kafka.
* Experience with workflow orchestration and platform tooling such as **Apache Airflow**, including maintainable DAGs and operational business-critical workflows.
* Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with **data modeling**, query optimization, and data storage systems.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: data lake or lakehouse architectures; columnar or analytical databases; or NoSQL or distributed database systems.
* Experience owning production-grade batch and/or streaming pipelines, including data quality, observability, schema evolution, backfills, recovery procedures, and SLA management.
* Hands-on experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating production-grade microservices.
* Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices; experience with Helm is an advantage.
* Familiarity with **LLM** application and workflow frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
* Ability to evaluate technologies, make sound technical decisions, and communicate trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration, mentoring, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while balancing platform improvements with near-term product delivery.
* Pragmatic, results-driven approach and commitment to strong engineering fundamentals.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg; ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow.
* Experience with Pandas/Polars and building **data services/APIs (e.g., FastAPI).**
* Experience building LLM-powered agents or chat assistants (RAG, tool/function calling, workflow or multi-agent orchestration) using modern frameworks and platforms.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation) and cloud security fundamentals (IAM, secrets, encryption).
* Experience with observability tooling (metrics/logging/tracing) and cost/performance optimization for distributed workloads.
* Experience building applications with React and Node.js.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Product Test Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid Product Test Engineer role focuses on validating complex health care administration solutions built on Facets and TriZetto Elements for payer and provider clients. The engineer will design and execute robust functional and integration tests for enrollment benefit configuration and claims workflows ensuring high reliability and regulatory compliance. The role impacts health plan members and care providers through improved accuracy reduced processing defects and enhanced digital

**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test scenarios for Facets enrollment workflows that ensure accurate member intake processing and reduce downstream defects in payer and provider operations.
* Develop and maintain reusable test cases and data sets for Facets benefit configuration that validate complex plan designs and improve reliability of benefit administration for diverse health plan offerings.
* Execute functional integration and regression testing for Facets claims processing to confirm correct adjudication logic and to minimize claim payment errors that impact providers and members.
* Coordinate end to end test cycles across Facets and TriZetto Elements modules to verify seamless data flow between enrollment benefits and claims components within integrated product releases.
* Analyze production like defects and root causes in payer and provider use cases and translate findings into targeted regression coverage and improvements in test design for future releases.
* Collaborate closely with product managers business analysts and configuration teams to clarify requirements and ensure test conditions accurately reflect real world payer and provider scenarios.
* Create and refine test data that mirrors complex provider networks member benefit combinations and claim scenarios to strengthen test depth and increase confidence in product behavior under varied conditions.
* Document clear test results defect details and impact assessments that help development and configuration teams resolve issues quickly and maintain high quality standards for client delivery.
* Use domain knowledge of payer and provider processes to validate compliance with business rules contractual obligations and regulatory expectations within Facets and TriZetto Elements solutions.
* Support performance and volume oriented test activities by modeling realistic enrollment loads benefit updates and claim submission patterns that reflect large scale health plan operations.
* Engage with implementation and support teams in a hybrid work model to review client specific configurations and share test insights that reduce implementation risk and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks checklists and best practices for Facets and TriZetto Elements testing to improve efficiency and consistency across product releases.
* Mentor junior test engineers in understanding payer and provider workflows and in applying structured test design techniques that raise overall team capability and product quality.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in Facets enrollment testing with detailed understanding of member eligibility rules group structures and related configuration impacts on downstream processes.
* Apply advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration by designing tests that cover complex benefit hierarchies accumulators and cost sharing rules for varied health plan products.
* Utilize practical expertise with Facets claims modules to verify claim pricing accumulation and payment rules while ensuring alignment with payer reimbursement policies and provider contracts.
* Bring working experience in TriZetto Elements to validate integration points configuration consistency and data exchange between TriZetto tools and core Facets components.
* Exhibit solid domain understanding of payer operations such as enrollment premium handling benefits administration and claims adjudication to design realistic and business relevant test scenarios.
* Apply provider domain knowledge to test scenarios involving provider contracting reimbursement patterns and network participation attributes reflected in claims and benefit configuration.
* Use strong analytical and problem solving abilities to interpret complex defects reproduce issues reliably and recommend test coverage enhancements based on observed patterns in health care data.

Senior Software Engineer – Java Application Support

  
  

Application Support & Managed Services | Java Technology Stack

  
  

Role Title: Senior Software Engineer – Application Support (Java / Spring Boot)

  
  

Grade / Band: Senior Software Engineer

  
  

Experience: 4–8 years, with at least 2 years supporting production Java applications

  
  

Location: [Location] – hybrid; shift coverage, weekend releases and on-call required

  
  

Reports To: Lead – Java Application Support

  
  

Role Summary

  
  

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to provide L2/L3 support. You will investigate production incidents down to the code level, write and test defect fixes, tune performance, and take ownership of the root cause analysis for issues in your area. Because the team owns the codebase, this role blends production support discipline with real development capability — expect to spend your time across log analysis, thread and heap dumps, SQL investigation, and the IDE.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

L2 / L3 Incident Resolution

  
  

Investigate and resolve incidents and service requests for assigned Java applications within agreed SLAs.

  
  

Perform detailed log analysis across application, integration, middleware and database layers to isolate root cause.

  
  

Analyse thread dumps, heap dumps and GC behaviour to diagnose hangs, memory leaks, slowness and crashes.

  
  

Reproduce production defects in lower environments and confirm the failure path in the source code.

  
  

Participate in major incident bridges, providing clear technical analysis and timely updates.

  
  

Escalate to the Lead or development team with complete diagnostic evidence when the fix is outside support scope.

  
  

Code-Level Fixes & Application Maintenance

  
  

Develop, unit test and raise pull requests for production defect fixes and hotfixes in Java/Spring Boot.

  
  

Implement approved configuration changes, property updates, data corrections and remediation scripts.

  
  

Deliver small enhancements and change requests routed to the support team.

  
  

Write and validate SQL data fix scripts, with rollback statements prepared before execution.

  
  

Follow the change process for every production modification — no undocumented changes.

  
  

Problem Management & Performance

  
  

Own root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact issues in your area and contribute to formal RCA documents.

  
  

Profile and tune application performance — slow endpoints, inefficient queries, connection pool sizing, caching, JVM parameters.

  
  

Maintain the known-error database and workaround library.

  
  

Identify supportability weaknesses (poor logging, missing error handling, absent retries) and raise them for remediation.

  
  

Monitoring, Automation & Release Support

  
  

Monitor application health, batch schedules, queues and integration flows; act on alerts before user impact.

  
  

Build and maintain health-check scripts, alerts and dashboards; close monitoring gaps proactively.

  
  

Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting to reduce manual effort and human error.

  
  

Support deployments and release windows — execute steps, validate post-implementation health, and be ready to roll back.

  
  

Support UAT and regression cycles by triaging defects and coordinating fixes.

  
  

Documentation & Mentoring

  
  

Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.

  
  

Enable L1/SE colleagues to handle repeatable issues independently through shift-left documentation and coaching.

  
  

Mentor junior engineers on debugging technique, not just on individual fixes.

  
  

Complete structured shift handovers so no issue is lost between shifts.

  
  

Technical Skills

  
  

Java Troubleshooting & Development

  
  

Strong hands-on Java (8/11/17) — you must be able to read, debug, modify and unit test production code.

  
  

Spring Boot and Spring Framework — configuration, dependency injection, transactions, Actuator, profiles.

  
  

Hibernate/JPA and its production failure modes; ability to drop to native SQL when needed.

  
  

JVM diagnostics: jstack, jmap, jstat, jcmd, VisualVM, Eclipse MAT; reading GC logs and diagnosing OutOfMemoryError.

  
  

Debugging concurrency issues — deadlocks, thread pool exhaustion, race conditions.

  
  

JUnit and Mockito for validating fixes before release.

  
  

Platform, Data & Tooling

  
  

Application servers: Tomcat, JBoss/WildFly, WebLogic or WebSphere — datasources, connection pools, thread pools.

  
  

Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server — complex SQL, execution plans, locking and blocking analysis.

  
  

Messaging: Kafka (consumer lag, offsets), RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ or IBM MQ; REST/SOAP APIs, XML/JSON, SFTP interfaces.

Docker and working familiarity with Kubernetes/OpenShift troubleshooting.

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.

This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.

* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.

* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Job Description**

title: Senior Quantitative Researcher/Scientist
description:
We are looking for a **Senior Quantitative Researcher** to take a leading role in developing and governing the statistical methodology behind our daily KPI indices.

Our methodology determines how alternative data is transformed into robust estimates of company performance, including how models are specified, validated and governed before publication. It is developed and maintained by the OXDS team and runs every day across several hundred published indices. This is a new, dedicated senior position created to advance that methodology, introducing deeper statistical modelling, stronger uncertainty quantification, more robust approaches for sparse and heterogeneous data, and methods that continue to perform as our data sources and products evolve.

In this role, you will be the senior statistical voice for the index production system, working within the OXDS team alongside software engineers and with data scientists across the product teams.

**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Lead the statistical methodology of index production end to end: model specification, estimation, adjustment, validation and forecasting.
* Propose and develop substantial methodological enhancements to improve the quality of our KPI models beyond our existing approaches.
* Own the adjustment and drift-control methodology: scaling, bounds, clipping and the treatment of outstanding corrections, including how thresholds and windows are selected and evidenced.
* Own the statistical treatment of panel and source data before modelling, including coverage, reporting lag, sample drift and representativeness.
* Set standards for the model lifecycle, including specification, validation, backtesting, retraining, and evaluation using only the information available at the time of publication.
* Own the revision methodology for published series, including when restatement is justified and what historical consistency it should preserve.
* Own the statistical logic behind production quality assurance, including input monitoring, outlier detection, alert calibration, and distinguishing data issues from model issues.
* Maintain clear methodology specifications that engineers and data scientists can build against, and review methodological changes proposed by product teams.
* Validate numerical equivalence when statistical libraries or scientific dependencies are upgraded.
* Implement methodology as tested, production-quality Python and take accountability for the statistical correctness of published outputs.
* Deliver training sessions to other data scientists to upskill them in our methodology, especially for new methods you have developed.
* Mentor data scientists and raise statistical standards across the wider team.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Experience**

* 5+ years of work experience in applied statistics, econometrics or quantitative data science or a PhD in a relevant field.
* Demonstrated experience owning statistical methodology in a production system where modelling decisions reached external users.
* Postgraduate training in statistics, econometrics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent applied experience.

### **Statistics & Methodology**

* Deep understanding of regression modelling and statistical inference, including diagnostics, constrained estimation and uncertainty estimation.
* Strong time-series expertise, including forecasting, seasonality, calendar effects, structural breaks and time-series cross-validation.
* Strong understanding and experience with two or more of the following:

o Bayesian modelling, particularly hierarchical models;

o Kalman filtering;

o Errors-in-variables models;

o Change point detection;

o Conformal prediction;

o Forecast combination (e.g. Bates and Granger method).

* Experience with sampling and panel methodology, including selection bias, unbalanced panels, reweighting and representativeness.
* Experience calibrating thresholds and uncertainty measures for automated decision systems, with sound judgement around false positives and missed errors.
* Ability to reason about methodology under production constraints such as data revisions, missing inputs, short histories and backward compatibility of published series.

### **Python**

* Fluent Python with the statistical stack, including statsmodels, scipy, pandas and NumPy.
* Comfortable contributing to a large shared production codebase using version control, code review and automated testing.
* Experience writing statistical code that runs unattended, with appropriate validation, reproducibility and failure handling.

### **Other**

* Strong SQL skills.
* Excellent written communication and the ability to explain statistical reasoning clearly to non-statistical audiences.
* Comfortable acting as the methodological authority within a multidisciplinary team and challenging weak approaches with clear reasoning.
* Fluent in English.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with alternative data, nowcasting or KPI/revenue estimation using sources such as transaction, web or app data.
* Experience with uncertainty quantification for time series, including prediction intervals, conformal or adaptive conformal methods.
* Experience with one or more advanced modelling approaches, such as Bayesian modelling, state-space models, hierarchical or pooled modelling, forecast reconciliation, or other relevant statistical methods.
* Experience with index construction methodology, including chaining and rebasing.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED**

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. title: SFDC Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response

* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

title: Senior Specialist - Embedded Testing
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Responsible for Handling an Embedded Testing Team across Protection & Controls product lines and responsible for planning, designing, developing, and executing comprehensive test strategies to ensure the delivery of high‑quality products. This role involves close collaboration with development, product, and engineering teams to test/validate embedded products and Will lead testing strategies, identify issues early, automate test processes, and drive continuous quality improvements, develop automation frameworks.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

* Conduct comprehensive functionality testing across protection and control products to ensure reliable operation under normal and fault conditions.
* Validate correct operation of protection schemes by simulating fault conditions and verifying product response.
* Expert in validating and testing industrial communication protocols like IEC 61850, IEC 60870, Modbus, DNP3
* Design and develop advanced test automation frameworks and scripts to enhance testing efficiency, accuracy, and coverage for embedded systems and communication protocols.
* Design, develop, and operate advanced Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Firmware-in-the-Loop (FIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test environments to simulate real-world grid conditions and validate embedded firmware performance.
* Extensive hands-on experience in testing and validating embedded communication interfaces and tools, including Serial Port Monitor, Tera Term, and Wireshark, along with modules such as Wi-Fi, BLE, USB, and Ethernet, ensuring reliable connectivity, data integrity, and protocol compliance.
* Conduct R&D for power system domain applications.
* Perform deep-dive debugging of embedded firmware and hardware interactions during system failures, utilizing oscilloscopes and logic analysers for detailed signal and timing analysis.
* Develop and interpret wiring diagrams to ensure accurate system understanding and effective fault isolation.
* Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and design documents.
* Define and implement overall testing strategies including functional, regression, performance, security, and automation testing.
* Knowledge in understanding Product Requirements, Marketing Requirements and deriving System Integration test cases.
* Contribute to risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Should be highly creative in coming up with out-of-box scenarios for testing and bugs
* Identify, analyse, and document defects using tracking tools
* Track defects through resolution and verify fixes
* Provide clear test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to ensure testability and quality in every stage of development.
* Participate in design and code reviews with a quality-first perspective.
* Advocate for quality engineering practices and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers.
* Lead test initiatives for large features or project modules.
* Perform end-to-end system analysis and design of complex systems (hardware, software, communications).
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Help establish and refine QA standards, processes, and documentation.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in electrical/Electronics/Software Engineering (or) Equivalent
* Minimum 10 to 15 years related Experiences in Protective Relaying & Substation Communication Solutions and Lateral Protection (Medium/High Voltage Products).
* Should have programming knowledge on Python, java, java script, Bash,Golang.
* Hands-on experience with IEC 61850 testing tools (e.g., Omicron IED Scout, Triangle Microworks test harness).
* Experience developing products in an Agile environment and understanding of SDLC, STLC
* Knowledge of secure communication protocols, authentication mechanisms, and data encryption techniques
* Experience with version control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP)
* Added advantageof having Certified ISTQB Foundation level
* Experience on working with the test kit like Omicron CMC356,500, CPC100 and various make secondary/primary injection test kit
* Should have experience in Designing, Developing, and Testing real time embedded products.
* Should have knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical and Embedded Parameters
* Must Demonstrate consistent and sustainable application of problem solving and analytical skills.
* Competent working with Microsoft Office & related software operating on a Windows platform.

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.
