description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables:**

The incumbent will be accountable for the comprehensive management and delivery of projects related to their specific commodity within the tractor parts development domain. This pivotal role ensures seamless execution aligned with strategic objectives and quality standards.

* **Project Management and Coordination:**
    
  Take ownership of the end-to-end project lifecycle including initial technical sign off, synthesis of competitive quotations, and rigorous adherence to project milestones and timelines. Engage actively in feasibility studies, risk assessments, and provide recommendations to guarantee project viability and success.
* **Cost, Quality, and Delivery (QCD):**
    
  Meet established material cost targets while maintaining strict budgetary discipline. Ensure that all deliverables meet or exceed quality standards, focusing on manufacturability, tooling feasibility, and supplier capabilities to consistently fulfill QCD commitments.
* **Process Compliance & Governance:**
    
  Oversee the implementation of Manufacturing Process Development System (MPDS) gateways, ensuring compliance with Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) and Part Submission Warrant (PSW) requirements. Collaborate closely with Centres of Excellence (COEs) to uphold regulatory, safety, and quality compliance standards.
* **Capacity & Volume Planning:**
    
  Analyze production capacity against forecasted volumes to prevent bottlenecks, working alongside design teams to facilitate first-time-right delivery. Ensure scalability of processes and readiness for volume ramp-up phases.
* **Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics:**
    
  Develop, maintain and interpret Management Information System (MIS) reports reflecting project progress, key issues like High Impact Hourly Rate (HIHR), Material Inspection Material Rejection (MIMR), and Low Incoming Lot Rejection (LILR). Use these insights to drive continuous improvement.
* **Support & Collaboration:**
    
  Engage and coordinate with Home Commodity teams for technical and delivery support. Act as a liaison with COEs for technical sign-offs, ensuring stakeholder alignment and transparent communication.
* **Decision-making and Escalation:**
    
  Apply discernment in escalating critical issues to Senior Leadership, such as delayed Statement of Requirements (SOR), part development delays impacting bottlenecks, or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) discrepancies involving design and procurement teams.

This role necessitates a proactive approach with effective cross-functional collaboration, ensuring project objectives are met on schedule, within budget, and at the highest quality standards.

**Experience**
--------------

**Experience:**

Applicants should possess between 7 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in tractor parts development or related automotive sectors. Experience must include significant exposure to project management and the execution of complex technical projects within a manufacturing environment.

Preferred experience encompasses the following:

* Leading cross-functional teams through the complete product development cycle, with demonstrated success managing timelines, costs, and quality targets.
* Hands-on involvement with proprietary mechanical components as well as the electrical and electronic systems specific to agricultural machinery.
* Experience in supplier evaluation, tooling feasibility assessments, and vendor management.
* Proficiency in interpreting technical documents such as Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), technical drawings, and Process Control Plans.
* Track record in implementing and monitoring manufacturing processes aligned with MPDS guidelines.

Exposure to use of advanced data management tools such as SAP for material resource planning and procurement, together with proficiency in Microsoft Excel for robust data analysis, will be highly advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

**Industry Preferred:**

Expertise within the agricultural machinery and tractor manufacturing industry is strongly preferred. Experience within companies specialising in tractor design, development, and production will provide a solid foundation for success in this role.

Preferred industry sectors include but are not limited to:

* Tractor and agricultural equipment manufacturing
* Agricultural parts suppliers specialising in mechanical and electronic components
* OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers serving the farm machinery market
* Heavy engineering companies involved in outdoor equipment manufacturing.

Familiarity with industry regulations, standards, and emerging trends in tractor engineering and sustainability will be considered highly valuable.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Qualifications:**

A strong educational background is essential, with a minimum requirement of a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (BE) degree obtained through a regular full-time program in a relevant engineering discipline.

The ideal fields of study include:

* Mechanical Engineering
* Automotive Engineering
* Electrical or Electronics Engineering (preferably with coursework or experience related to tractor systems)
* Production or Industrial Engineering with a focus on manufacturing systems.

Additional professional certifications in project management, quality assurance, and supply chain management will be beneficial to support knowledge and performance in the role.

Continual professional development and participation in industry forums or workshops related to tractor engineering and parts development are encouraged.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

description:
**The Opportunity**

Joining Amex Tech means helping build and operate technology that supports critical business capabilities at enterprise scale. We are seeking an experienced **Director of Engineering** to lead a portfolio within the Operations Data and Analytics organization spanning **ServiceNow and IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategy platform engineering, and observability and operational analytics for the Customer Journey availability program** .

A significant area of focus will be the continued development and modernization of **Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB)** capabilities that support these processes. This leader will help ensure these capabilities operate as integrated enterprise technology products, with strong engineering practices, reliable data, appropriate governance, and roadmaps aligned to the needs of the broader technology organization.

This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services.

The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions.

* Significant experience leading enterprise engineering, platform engineering, SRE, production management, data, or technology operations organizations.

* Strong experience with **ServiceNow and enterprise ITSM/ITIL processes** , particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
* Strong understanding of **industry standards and established ITIL practices** associated with Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management.
* Experience developing or overseeing **CMDB capabilities that directly support Incident, Problem, and Change processes** .
* Demonstrated experience participating in and influencing **ServiceNow platform roadmaps through established governance, planning, and prioritization forums** in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to influence platform direction across organizations where roadmap ownership, process ownership, engineering execution, and business priorities may reside with different teams.
* Experience with enterprise observability platforms such as **Dynatrace and Splunk** , including modern telemetry and monitoring practices.
* Strong background in application development, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and production engineering.

* Strong understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and reliability engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to influence peers and leaders and align teams across complex global organizations.

description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are looking for a highly skilled **Engineer III, AI Science** to design, build, and scale our next generation of AI systems. In this senior technical role, you will be a key driver in transitioning our machine learning capabilities from traditional predictive modeling to advanced Agentic and Prescriptive AI paradigms.

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agentic AI & LLM Development**

* Design, build, and deploy multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
* Develop robust LLM-based applications capable of reasoning, tool-use, and executing complex, multi-step tasks for dynamic customer interactions and internal automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge), and prompt-engineering best practices to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant agent behavior in production.

**2. Predictive & Prescriptive Modeling**

* Build state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence models, tree-based models) for forecasting customer behavior, churn, propensity, and lifetime value (CLTV).
* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.

**3. Production Engineering & MLOps**

* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.

**4. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of applied industry experience in machine learning, AI science, or data engineering (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* **Technical Skills:**Advanced proficiency in **Python** and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying **LLMs and Agentic AI** (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in **Predictive and Prescriptive ML** methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition  
Leads the design, development, testing, and architectural oversight of safety‑critical autonomy applications; collaborates with cross‑functional teams to meet internal and external needs.

Responsibilities  

* Designing safety‑critical features end‑to‑end — translating requirements into technical designs for sensor data processing, object detection, threat assessment, and automated safety responses
* Guiding teams on real‑time embedded software design practices, ensuring components are modular, testable, and maintainable.
* Documenting architecture specifications, software design descriptions, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.
* Supporting developers in building and validating detection and decision‑making algorithms across multiple vehicle and machine configurations
* Utilizing appropriate tools to debug, test, and maintain software and hardware systems, leading verification and validation activities.
* Lead design and code reviews with focus on safety, correctness, numerical stability, and handling of degraded or missing data

Degree Requirement  

* Requires a degree in Electronic/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science curriculum.
* More than 10 years of relevant industry experience in developing C++ applications

Skill Descriptors

Real‑Time Systems Integration
  
Knowledge of real‑time system architecture and multi‑system integration across sensing, compute, and actuation domains.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and validates end‑to‑end data flows meeting real‑time latency and throughput requirements.
* Integrates software across CAN, Ethernet, and middleware in multi‑ECU architectures.
* Diagnoses timing, synchronization, and data‑consistency issues in distributed systems.
* Defines interface contracts including schemas, timing budgets, and failure modes.
* Evaluates system‑level trade‑offs between compute load, bandwidth, and safety margins.

Artificial Intelligence & Sensor Fusion
  
Knowledge of AI and sensor fusion concepts and methods, with awareness of applicable industry standards and safety expectations; ability to develop and apply perception and prediction algorithms for autonomous systems.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and implements sensor fusion pipelines integrating radar, camera, and lidar data into a unified world model.
* Develops and tunes object detection, tracking, and prediction algorithms for real‑time autonomous decision‑making in safety‑critical contexts.
* Evaluates trade‑offs between algorithmic accuracy, latency, computational cost, and system‑level safety constraints on embedded platforms.
* Applies probabilistic and statistical techniques to noisy sensor data, accounting for uncertainty and failure modes.
* Supports validation of perception and prediction systems against ground truth, field data, and applicable standards or guidelines.
* Mentors others on integrating AI/ML components into safety‑critical software architectures.

Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies with ability to deliver, validate, and manage high‑quality software products.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Applies multiple vendor‑provided or in‑house SDLC methodologies with testing embedded across all phases.
* Converts requirements into robust, reviewable designs with explicit verification and testability considerations.
* Leads activities across all SDLC phases including design, implementation, integration, testing, validation, and release.
* Defines and executes test strategies, plans, and cases to validate functionality, error handling, reliability, and failure modes.
* Evaluates and consults on effective SDLC and testing practices using iterative and agile approaches.

Software Development  
Knowledge of programming languages, tools, and Linux‑based development; ability to design, implement, debug, and maintain software for embedded and distributed systems.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and develops software on Linux platforms, including embedded and system‑level components.
* Applies modern C++ (C++11/14/17), including concurrency, RAII, smart pointers, and memory‑safe patterns, in Linux environments.
* Uses Linux debugging and profiling tools to diagnose functional and performance issues.
* Oversees large development efforts aligned with system and architectural design.
* Evaluates programming trade‑offs across performance, memory, safety, and maintainability.
* Coaches junior engineers on programming best practices and Linux workflows.

Problem Solving & Technical Troubleshooting
  
Knowledge of structured problem‑solving methods and advanced troubleshooting techniques across organizational, hardware, software, and system domains; ability to resolve high‑impact issues.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Leads structured problem resolution and root‑cause analysis for complex, high‑impact issues.
* Analyzes complex technical problems and applies appropriate diagnostic techniques based on context and impact.
* Resolves critical or wide‑impact hardware, software, and communication failures.
* Drives urgency, prioritization, and decision‑making based on business impact.
* Directs cross‑team and multi‑vendor issue resolution and coach others on advanced troubleshooting techniques.

Additional Information  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.

**Posting Dates:**

October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026

Nice-to-Have

description:

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. **Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.

* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.

* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

**Position Description:**

Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.

* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.

* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.

* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.

* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.

* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).

* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.

* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.

* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements

* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations

* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations

* SQL queries and analysis

* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.

* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.

* Designing and maintaining custom applications.

* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products

* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.

* Excellent team player.

* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.

Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.

OFFICE

About Comcast Next Generation Access Networks (NGAN) NGAN (Next Gen Access Networks) is a group within Headquarters at Comcast that partners with all three divisional Engineering & Technical Operations teams to drive expansion, new technologies and continuous improvement into the ‘last mile’ of the network.

**Job Description**

**Job Description**
-------------------

Are you passionate about digital media, entertainment, and access technologies? Do you like big challenges and working within a highly motivated team environment?

The Next Gen Access Technologies team is a small and fast-moving team of world-class experts who are innovating in end-to-end IP services delivery. As a senior integration engineer on the next gen access team, you will design and develop software orchestration solutions used in our new product testing lab to verify the technology that will enable next generation services to our customers. We are a team that thrives on big challenges, results, quality, and agility.

**Who does the Next Gen Access Technologies team work with?**

The team manages new technology development and deployment programs that require coordination across multiple teams. There is a strong, collaborative relationship between Next Gen Access, developers, vendors, QA engineers, deployment and operations teams as partners in the delivery of quality systems and services. We work at all levels of the organization to plan and deliver new services and service capabilities.

**What are some interesting problems you’ll be working on?**

In this role, you will be part of a team that is responsible for the development of automated software suites that validate Comcast’s next generation access network capabilities in an R&D test lab environment. You will automate time-consuming manual test processes by orchestrating data flows from a variety of systems to build a “big picture” of the system state as it progresses though operational modes. In addition, you will work with the system engineers on developing applications for debugging and monitoring live systems in the field.

**Where can you make an impact?**

You’ll be working with the best and brightest minds in Comcast to verify the access networks infrastructure and products that will power the next generation of services. Success in this role is characterized by a higher speed to market as well as fewer customer-facing defects and outages of equipment and services that delight and entertain our customers.

* Develop solutions to convert manual data-gathering processes across multiple systems and devices to fully automated, reliable software tools
* Develop tools to integrate parallel data streams from a variety of APIs, tools, logs, and systems into a cohesive unit using a variety of technologies.
* Develop tools to orchestrate device interactions on multiple systems.
* Develop tools to assist the system engineers in debugging and monitoring systems in the field.
* Work collaboratively on a small development team.
* Be available for live meetings with USA-based team members, usually in the evening, local time.
* Participate with fellow team members and the test leads during the automation design phase.
* Support the lab test team in the execution of automated tools you develop.

**Skills & Requirements**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 6-8 years of software development.
* Strong preference for experience with business process automation, EIA, and other software orchestration technologies and Python based automation frameworks.
* Strong preference for experience with asynchronous programming
* Experience with front-end system development like React
* Experience with regular expressions and predictive text data processing
* Experience with cable network architecture, specification, engineering, validation a plus.
* Experience with AI Agent, Skill, MCP is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Keen attention to detail and high level of commitment.

Bachelor's Degree

5-7 Years

  + A track record of shipping complex, multi-quarter work on time — and of being the person who found the risk early.
  + Demonstrated ability to lift a team's engineering practices, not just your own output, through standards, review and mentorship.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a design doc an executive and a junior engineer both understand.
  + Comfortable with influence rather than authority: you get the team to a better answer without owning anyone's performance review.
  + Fluent in Agile delivery and the tooling around it (Jira, Confluence, Git branching and rebasing).
  + Comfortable working with a distributed US–India team and with customers directly.

**What you'll be doing:**

  + Run sprint-level execution: identify risk early, surface and clear blockers, and keep commitments honest and predictable.
  + Be the single technical point of accountability when a release slips, a migration goes sideways or a customer escalation lands on the team.
  + Drive production health for your services — SLOs, on-call quality, alert hygiene, and root-cause follow-through rather than repeat firefighting.  
  Set technical direction  
  + Own the architecture of your domain: service boundaries, data models, event contracts and integration patterns, aligned with the FourKites North Star architecture.
  + Write and review design documents; make the calls that need making and document the trade-offs behind them.
  + Evaluate frameworks, tools and third-party/partner APIs; decide what we build, what we buy and what we integrate.
  + Maintain a live view of technical debt in your domain and negotiate a steady share of roadmap capacity to pay it down.
  + Design for the scale we actually run at — millions of supply chain events a day, across 80+ countries and 1,600+ global brands.

  Hold the engineering bar for the whole team  
  + Define and enforce the team's engineering standards: coding conventions, test strategy and coverage expectations, PR size and review turnaround, branching, observability and documentation.
  + Review code with intent — catch design problems, not just style — and keep review latency low so the team stays unblocked.
  + Make quality measurable. Watch and improve the signals that matter: change failure rate, revert and hotfix rate, escaped defects, MTTR, cycle time from first commit to production.
  + Raise the floor, not just the ceiling: make sure best practices hold across every engineer on the team, including the newest one.
  + Champion secure-by-default and well-instrumented software — tests, tracing, metrics and alerts are part of done, not a follow-up ticket.  
  Multiply the team

  + Coordinate with tech leads in adjacent domains (OTR, Appointment Manager, Platform, AI Agents) on shared contracts and cross-team dependencies.
  + Represent your domain in architecture reviews and platform-level decisions.

  **Education Qualification:** Graduate from B.E/ B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech Background.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience with ocean and multimodal logistics data — container and booking milestones, bills of lading, carrier and NVOCC feeds, terminal and port data, AIS/vessel tracking, customs events.
* Familiarity with logistics integration standards and partner ecosystems (EDI/EDIFACT, X12, DCSA APIs, INTTRA, CargoSmart, freight forwarder and carrier APIs).

For both

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by

title: L2 Managed Service Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.

· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.

· Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.

· Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.

· Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.

· Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.

· Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.

· Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.

· Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).

· Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.

· Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).

· Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.

· Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

Required Skills and Experience

Observability Platform Skills

· 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.

· Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.

· Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).

· APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.

· Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.

· RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.

· Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.

· Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.

· Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.

· Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.

· Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.

· Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

Application and Architecture Understanding

· Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.

· Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.

· Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.

· Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

Good to Have

· Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).

· Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.

· Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

Soft Skills

· Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.

· Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.

· Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.

· Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.

· Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Details

· **Level:** L2 (Mid-level, Managed Services)

· **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed

· **Reporting To:** L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.

People Leadership & Talent Development  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

### **Degree Requirement**

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.

### **Skill Descriptors**

**Engineering Management**

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.

**Data Science & Machine Learning**

Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.

**Delivery & Execution**

Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.

**Communication & Collaboration**

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.

### **Software Development Life Cycle**

Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

### **Artificial Intelligence**

Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

### **Programming & Technical Literacy**

Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists

description:
**Job Summary**

Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.

* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.

* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Digital Payments and Emerging Markets
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you’re passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase.
* Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems.

  
A day in the life  
You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next.  
  
About the team  
The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable.  
  
We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Engineer - L2 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.
* Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.
* Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.
* Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.
* Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.
* Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).
* Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.
* Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.
* Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Observability Platform Skills**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.
* Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.
* Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).
* APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.
* Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.
* RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.
* Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.
* Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

**Application and Architecture Understanding**

* Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.
* Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.
* Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

**Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.
* Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.
* Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L2 (Mid-level, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed
* **Reporting To:** L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

  
A day in the life  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.

Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times  
  
About the team  
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as C, C++, Java, or Perl
* Experience with automation, testing, or monitoring framework development
* 1+ years of DevOps or SysOps in a large-scale software development environment experience
* Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Python scripting language

Own the end‑to‑end data architecture for the Command Centre – how data flows from operational source systems across product domains (e.g. Contracts, Ocean) through to the Control Tower consumption layer.


Define the target‑state data architecture and transition roadmap, including the layering model (landing, raw, integrated/curated, consumption) and the storage, compute, and serving choices at each layer.


Design the canonical, cross‑domain data layer that gives the Control Tower one consistent representation of the core business objects, independent of the source systems they originate from.


Define master and reference data requirements, entity resolution, and cross‑system key mapping so that events from different systems resolve to the same business entity.


Establish data domain boundaries, data ownership, and data product definitions aligned to the Command Centre operating model.


Produce and maintain core architecture artefacts – conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data flow and lineage diagrams, integration maps, and architecture decision records.


Data Integration \& Pipeline Architecture


Architect real‑time, near real‑time, and batch ingestion patterns – streaming, event‑driven, CDC, API, and scheduled – and define which pattern applies to which source and use case.


Define the operational event model and payload standards for the milestones, status changes, and exceptions that drive Control Tower views.


Design pipeline patterns for reliability at scale: idempotency, replay, late‑arriving and out‑of‑order events, backfill, and reconciliation back to source.


Set standards for orchestration, dependency management, error and dead‑letter handling, and pipeline observability.


Define and agree data contracts and SLAs with source system teams, covering schema, frequency, volume, and change management.


Define latency, freshness, and throughput targets per data domain and ensure the architecture demonstrably meets them.


Data Modelling \& Semantic / KPI Layer


Design the dimensional, event, and state models required for end‑to‑end milestone tracking, cycle time, dwell, and exception analysis.


Architect the semantic and KPI layer so that each metric is defined once, certified, and reused consistently across Control Tower views and downstream reporting.


Model for drill‑down, so an alert on the Control Tower can be traced to transaction‑level detail and root cause without leaving the platform.


Define the historisation approach – slowly changing dimensions, snapshots, and point‑in‑time reporting – to support trend and retrospective analysis.


Design aggregation, pre‑computation, and caching strategies so Control Tower dashboards meet response‑time expectations at production data volumes.


Data Quality, Governance \& Security


Define data quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds at each architectural layer, and design how failures are detected, quarantined, and escalated.


Ensure Control Tower alerting is built on trusted data – design the freshness, completeness, and validity checks that gate what is surfaced to operations.


Design end‑to‑end metadata and lineage capture, from source system field through to published KPI.


Design role‑based access, row and column level security, masking, retention, and audit into the data architecture rather than bolting it on later.


Ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture, cloud strategy, and BI governance standards, and work with the Tech Governance Lead on dataset certification.


Identify, document, and drive remediation of data architecture technical debt.


Delivery \& Execution


Translate the architecture into sprint‑ready designs, data contracts, and backlog items for data engineering and BI delivery teams.


Provide hands‑on technical direction – prototypes, proofs of concept, performance tuning, and resolution of complex modelling and pipeline problems.


Review data models, pipelines, and semantic layers for adherence to the agreed architecture.


Own volumetrics and capacity planning, and support performance, resilience, and reconciliation testing ahead of each Control Tower release.


Drive reuse of data products, models, and patterns across Command Centre use cases to reduce duplication and rework.


Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Collaboration


Partner with Command Centre operations and business owners to translate operational visibility and exception‑management needs into concrete data requirements.


Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, GDA, source system owners, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure and Cloud teams.


Present data architecture proposals to design authorities and governance forums for review and approval.


Communicate data design trade‑offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.


Mentor data engineers and modellers on architecture patterns, modelling standards, and design quality.
 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS


Education \& Experience


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.


Extensive experience as a data architect designing large‑scale, multi‑source data platforms, with hands‑on delivery experience rather than documentation only.


Proven experience designing the data architecture behind a control tower, command centre, or comparable real‑time operational visibility solution.


Track record of integrating operational and transactional source systems across multiple business domains.


Certifications in cloud data platforms, data architecture, or frameworks such as DAMA‑DMBOK or TOGAF are a plus.


Technical Competencies


* Deep data modelling expertise – conceptual, logical, and physical modelling; dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, and event/state modelling.
* Strong experience with cloud data platforms, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, and layered (medallion‑style) design.
* Hands‑on experience with streaming and event‑driven architectures, CDC, message/event platforms, and API‑based integration.
* Advanced SQL and data performance engineering – partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, query tuning, and cost optimisation.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation frameworks and with data quality and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge of master data management, reference data, and entity resolution techniques.
* Experience with metadata, lineage, and data catalogue tooling, and with certified dataset practices.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance, and the ability to design to them.
* Sufficient BI and visualisation knowledge to design a semantic layer that Control Tower dashboards can consume efficiently.

Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies


Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with source system owners.


Ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly and effectively.


High attention to detail combined with strategic, big‑picture thinking.


Sound judgement under operational pressure and in incident‑driven environments.


Proven ability to work across teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

**Technical Expertise**:

* Automobile domain experience.
* Experience supporting global applications.

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly.

* Mobile application development.

description:

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer / Quality Engineer with strong technical expertise in web and API automation, complete test lifecycle ownership, and a deep understanding of Agile methodologies.

**Key Responsibilities:***\**\*


**1\. Test Strategy and Planning**

* Perform complete test lifecycle activities including requirement analysis, test design, test execution, defect management, and test closure reporting.
* Ensure traceability between user stories, test cases, and defects.

Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both Web UI and API services using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Postman/Newman.

**7\. Release and Quality Governance**

* Ensure quality compliance and documentation for all production releases.
